title: 2025-03-27 Mainland China launch
source: The Mainland China edition launched. As it lagged roughly four years behind the JP server, it started directly from the JP 3rd-anniversary (3.5-year) version, skipping the first three years of events and gachas; event stories remained viewable at any time, with gachas re-run per the operator's schedule. (Source: NGA community public threads)
